cases.defect: The description incorrectly treats consonant-final adjectives as uniformly invariant in gender. Common A1 adjectives include español/española and trabajador/trabajadora. The forms required by this exercise are nevertheless correct.
cases.correction: Describe the illustrated invariant adjectives specifically, or qualify the generalization and distinguish consonant-final adjectives that change gender.

cases.element: context.taughtBefore[2] and context.targets[2].description: «Прикметники на -e та на приголосну: одна форма для обох родів»; task.hints[1].blocks[0].text: «Після приголосної в множині додаємо -es.»
cases.defect: The adjective description overgeneralizes: español/española demonstrates gender variation after a consonant. The plural hint also presents an unrestricted consonant rule, although nouns such as lunes remain unchanged. The answer hoteles grandes is correct.
cases.correction: Limit the adjective description to the invariant patterns illustrated. Scope the plural hint to this ending: «Іменники на -l утворюють множину за допомогою -es: hotel → hoteles.»
